title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
converter: cth_convert_sym_v8.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used tools/fetch/fetch-source.py

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: tools/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-09-22 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word volumes of C2026C00393 (C2026C00393VOL01.docx to C2026C00393VOL04.docx, joined; download sha256 56ce7f235064b5514ff273ceecb3432efe54fcc50befd21226c1f9b59d38ccc6, this deposit's download_sha256)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements, and with them any paragraph that held nothing else. cth_convert_sym_v8.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0BE —, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: One em dash (Symbol F0BE -> —) restored as new line 19506, in the endnotes' table of amending Acts (Volume 4): the "Application, saving and transitional provisions" cell of the Financial Sector Reform (Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Act (No. 1) 1999 row, a paragraph holding only the symbol, which the first conversion dropped whole. A diff against the first deposit shows no other change. Lines after 19505 move down by one; the formulas sidecar cites no line after 19505, so its references still hold.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: no encoding (baseline-2026-10, baseline-2026-11, naive-2026-10) relies on the endnotes' table of amending Acts
